summary: The comments from GCI Communication Corp. oppose limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance for ensuring affordable broadband access in schools and libraries, particularly in Alaska. The comment supports preserving existing E-Rate safeguards to ensure cost-effectiveness and program integrity. The text discusses proposed reforms to E-Rate administration, including targeted improvements to consultant registration and certification requirements. It supports preserving existing contracting flexibility and service-substitution requirements, while recommending clearer deadlines for certification and retaining the Lowest Corresponding Price framework. No specific claims about eligibility scope, budget cost efficiency, or other policy issues are made in the provided text. The FCC comments oppose imposing additional screen-time restrictions or requirements as conditions of E-Rate support, citing significant costs and administrative burdens for smaller schools and libraries. The comments also note that reducing or terminating E-Rate support could undermine the Commission's online-safety objectives.
